description: Approve applications that are waiting for the user's review (status "waiting_for_review" in getmattered_get_applications). Each approved application is submitted on the employer's own hiring system under the user's name and spends one of the user's applications. This cannot be undone: a submitted application cannot be withdrawn. Pass 1 to 25 application_ids. Approve only on the user's explicit go-ahead for those applications, such as a "yes" to a specific application. An application the plan or balance does not cover stays waiting and is reported as not sent. On a timeout or an error, call getmattered_get_applications before retrying; an approve that already went through is reported as already approved and is never sent twice. Do not use it for a job with no application yet; use getmattered_apply. Next: getmattered_get_applications to follow the submissions.

application_ids.description: Application ids to act on, 1 to 25 (e.g. [1550, 1551]), from getmattered_get_applications

name: getmattered_approve_applications

decision.description: The operation that ran: approve, reject, cancel, refine, re_prepare or set_stage.

notConfirmed.description: True when the user declined the confirmation prompt and nothing was sent.

reason.description: Machine reason when ok is false, or "already_approved" for an approve that had already gone through.

status.description: Our own record after the action. Never proof the employer received it.

title: Approve Applications
